verdict.rationale: Grok Build is mainly a terminal TUI agent, but it can run as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout, and the overview says it can be used through ACP "in other apps". That gives an indirect route to embedding it in ACP-capable editors, though no IDE is ever named. The "IDE integration" line refers to using the grok-4.7 model via the API, not to Grok Build itself. Missing for 10: a first-party IDE extension or named editor integration, documentation of in-IDE chat with editor context (selection, open files), and hands-on corroboration of IDE use.
